title: Quasi-coherent closure for the canonical derived tensor
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let E,F be objects of D(O_X) with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. Their tensor E\otimes^L F, using the canonical K-flat derived tensor monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], has quasi-coherent cohomology.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution P representing E and a complex N representing F. The canonical derived tensor is isomorphic to Q(Tot(P tensor N)) by its K-flat construction. Apply the tensor clause of derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh with the identity morphism of X, and transport quasi-coherence along this comparison: homology preserves isomorphisms and quasi-coherence is invariant under sheaf isomorphisms.
